visualCharacteristics: Product teaser: ~55/45 split, eyebrow + large name, price line, full-width gold primary button and secondary arrow link.
contentPattern: Product image beside product info (eyebrow, H2 name, price, description, delivery info, add-to-cart CTA, details link)
usage: One row with two cells. Cell 1: product image. Cell 2: eyebrow paragraph, H2 product name, price paragraph(s) starting with the currency (e.g. 'CHF 13.90'), description paragraphs, then a link-only paragraph for the main CTA and optional further link-only paragraphs for secondary links. Commerce is static: the CTA is a plain link to the product page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any single featured product or offer teaser. For plain image + text rows without price or CTA use columns-alternating.
